experiment: 首次有效闭合步的干预可预测性 (dev set)
frozen_2B_2C: results/freeze_2B.json (K=15, C=0.8, R_ON=0.025, R_OFF=0.015, Z band [0,0.055], Z_LOW_OK=0.02, Z_HY=[-0.005,0.075], DESC_NET=0.002, WIN=4)

decision_step.definition: 首个同时满足的控制步: (1) raw[-1]>0 闭合命令; (2) 回放内部2B状态机激活(会覆盖横向); (3) |prop[:2]-raw[:2]| > TOL
decision_step.replay: gate npz 上离线回放 CorrState(gated=False); 第 j+1 步输入=日志索引 j-1 的 eef/tgt (执行前观测), last_cmd=exec[j-1,-1]
decision_step.verification: 6 例已知 t*=[47,42,48,55,85,78] 全部复现; 回放 prop_action 与 diag npz 逐位一致(7/7, diff=0); init12_orig 负对照无触发

branches.alpha0: exec=raw at t*, 其余步冻结 2C; 已验证 exec-identical 于 gate (6/6 diff=0)
branches.alpha1: exec[:2]=prop[:2] at t*, 其余维度与后续步冻结 2C
branches.no_trigger: 无触发状态沿用 2C 结果计入分母

geometry.finger_mid_xy: = eef_xy (probe: fmid-eef=[0,0,+4mm] 常值, XY 精确相等)
geometry.finger_axis: 世界 Y (两pad张开距~8.6cm; 夹爪沿Y闭合)
geometry.box_frame: tgt_quat yaw -> 长轴=y方向(19.9mm), 短轴=x方向(9mm)

feasible_region_R.note: 短轴容差~垫带余量, 长轴容差=盒半长; 冻结值, 不拟合

rules.A: tug iff |e_S| > theta_A; e_S=决策步执行前 fmid-tgt 在盒短轴上的投影(m)
rules.B: tug iff |e_S|>theta_B1 AND cos(d,-e_xy)>theta_B2 AND trend4=|e_S|(t*-1)-|e_S|(t*-5)>theta_B3; d=prop-raw, e_xy=世界xy误差
rules.C: tug iff resid(e+M*prop+b) < resid(e+M*raw+b) - theta_C; e 为盒系 (e_L,e_S), M,b 最小二乘拟合 exec[:2]->Delta e (仅训练折 gate 轨迹), resid=盒系误差到 R 的距离
rules.contact_input: 不使用 (gate npz 无指垫-目标专属接触; B/C 信息一致)

threshold_selection: 阈值只在训练折上网格搜索, 目标=max(#rescue - #break), 平局取更少干预数; theta_A/theta_B1 in {2,...,20}mm, theta_B2 in {0,...,0.9}, theta_B3 in {-10,...,5}mm, theta_C in {0,...,5}mm

folds.method: 按 init 分组 5 折, 同 init 四条件同折; 每折留 4 init 评估, 16 init 训练

eval: 留出折上比较 always-a0 / always-a1 / A / B / C; 主指标=稳定抓取救回数、破坏数、干预次数; 另报任务结果; 6 个已分析病例单列; B vs C 分歧计数与结局影响
